A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same MAP study and complete supplementary material. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that pages 2–12 are identical; page 1 differs only in affiliation ordering, punctuation and the arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original MAP experiments on 2D and 3D tasks, including benchmark results in Tables 8–14 and component ablations in Tables 2–7.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original benchmark experiments and ablations, including the supplementary few-shot classification, ScanObjectNN and ShapeNetPart results.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same HybridNet architecture, random masking, row-wise autoregressive Transformer decoding and reconstruction objective. The 3D adaptation is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use ImageNet-1K, ADE20K, COCO 2017, ShapeNet, ModelNet40, ScanObjectNN and ShapeNetPart, with identical training and evaluation task coverage, including supplementary few-shot classification.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in corresponding experiments, including MAE, AR and CL pretraining comparisons and the Point-BERT and Point-MAE comparisons in the 3D experiments.

E3.justification: The metrics, resolutions, training budgets, preprocessing, voting settings and few-shot protocols are unchanged. For example, both specify 1600 ImageNet pretraining epochs and 400 fine-tuning epochs in Section 5.1.

E4.justification: The scanning-order, masking-ratio, hybrid-architecture, masking-strategy, decoder-mask and reconstruction-loss ablations in Tables 2–7 are identical. No supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Table 12 retains the same uncertainty-reporting practice for few-shot results. Neither version adds or revises run counts, seed information, significance testing or uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: All result entries and reported findings are unchanged, including Tables 1–14 and Figure 2. For example, HybridNet-B+MAP retains 84.9% ImageNet accuracy at 224 resolution, and HybridNet+MAP with voting retains 95.9% ModelNet40 accuracy.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, conditional factorization and loss formulation in Equations (1)–(5) are identical. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about combining local MAE with autoregressive modeling to improve hybrid and pure backbones on 2D and 3D tasks.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and applicability qualifications are identical. Section 2 retains the limitation that the MAP-pretrained hybrid architecture struggles to surpass an MAE-pretrained Transformer under the same settings.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures, optimizer settings, training schedules and A100 measurement information are unchanged. The code/checkpoint hyperlink has the same destination; only the period following its displayed text is removed.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 63 numbered reference entries are identical. No cited work or substantive positioning relative to prior research changes.

P1.justification: On page 1, affiliations 2 and 3 exchange order and author superscripts are updated, preserving the same author–institution associations. The period after the code URL is removed and the arXiv version/date stamp changes; the remaining prose and section structure are identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–6 and Tables 1–14 retain identical displays, captions, formatting and placement. The page layout, including the supplementary material, is unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 only reorders affiliation information, removes punctuation and updates the version stamp. The scientific content, empirical evidence, reproducibility information and substantive presentation remain unchanged, so these edits have no meaningful net effect on paper quality.
